verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence shows Decagon re-syncing knowledge sources on a schedule or when they change. The closest items are Suggestions, which detects knowledge gaps and drafts help-center content, and Duet, which iterates on agent logic. Both are adjacent features, not automatic knowledge-source synchronization.

support.subject: As a support ops lead, knowledge stays current automatically — the agent re-syncs sources on a schedule or on change, not via manual re-uploads
